newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African Sept CPI seen rising to 8 pct -analyst.
newsitem.headline: S.African Sept CPI seen rising to 8 pct -analyst.

text.p: South African consumer price inflation is likely to rise to an annual rate of 8.0 percent in September from 7.5 percent in August, according to Johan Rossouw, chief economist at stockbroker Huysamer Stals.
His forecast was based on a month-on-month increase of 0.54 percent, virtually unchanged from August's 0.5 percent.

The non-food component was expected to rise slightly to about 7.4 percent on an assumed 0.3-percent month-on-month rate of increase. The forecast for the food component was a gain to 10.1 percent on an assumed 1.6-percent month-on-month rate of increase. -- Johannesburg newsroom +27 11 482 1003
